-- Add and backfill customer loyalty tier from legacy_code.
-- Mapping sourced from codes.csv.
ALTER TABLE customers ADD COLUMN loyalty TEXT;

UPDATE customers
SET loyalty = CASE legacy_code
  WHEN 'A' THEN 'gold'
  WHEN 'B' THEN 'silver'
  WHEN 'C' THEN 'bronze'
  ELSE loyalty
END
